body.name: Rectangular not-yet-treated anchor
body.construction: \(\mathsf{RA}\) holds if and only if there exist choices \((b_j,q_j)_{j\in\mathcal J}\) such that \(b_j<g_j\le t_j<q_j\), \((g_j,b_j),(q_j,b_j),(q_j,t_j)\in\mathcal E_0\), and \(P_{\mathrm{obs}}(G=q_j)>0\) for every \(j\in\mathcal J\).
